_comment: The embedder registry: everything that varies from one embedder to the next, in
one place, keyed by model identity.
ONE MODEL SHIPS. bekko-a25m runs in the aimee-kb container from weights baked into
the image: 384-dim, no prefixes, ~6x nomic's CPU throughput, and it needs no
inference service, no GPU and no network. A deployment that wants a wider or stronger
embedder points AIMEE_EMBEDDER_URL at its own GPU endpoint instead — that is the
supported route above 384 dimensions, and it is why nomic is no longer bundled
despite winning the selection (0.6075 vs 0.5909 NDCG@10; see
docs/validation/embedder-selection-frozen-ab-v1.md). Bundling it cost 1.8GB of image
for a MoE that exists only as safetensors or GGUF.
WHY THIS FILE STILL EXISTS WITH ONE ENTRY. The per-model facts below are what nobody
can infer, and two of them fail SILENTLY when wrong — both have already gone wrong:
- pooling defaulted to `last`, correct for Qwen3 and wrong for nomic. Wrong
pooling yields vectors that are correctly shaped, correctly normalised and
simply wrong. Nothing errors; recall collapses.
- prefixes were absent entirely, so nomic served at 0.5823 NDCG@10 instead of
the 0.6075 it was selected on — below the runner-up it was chosen over.
bekko needs no prefixes, so the prefix machinery has no work to do today. It stays
because the failure it prevents is undetectable at runtime, and because an operator
overlay (EMBEDDERS_EXTRA) can declare a prefixed model.
EVERY FIELD IS REQUIRED, including empty prefixes. A model whose card defines no
prefixes declares that with empty strings — readers distinguish 'declared none'
from 'not registered', and refuse to serve the latter rather than guess.
Derive these from the model card, never by copying another entry. `prefixes` comes
from the card's usage section, `pooling` from its 1_Pooling/config.json, `dim` from
that file's word_embedding_dimension, and `context` from max_trained_positions (NOT
the tokenizer's model_max_length, which is often a smaller artifact).

notes: The shipped embedder. 0.5909 NDCG@10 on frozen-ab-v1 (10,000 cases / 26,473
documents), ~6x nomic's CPU throughput and half its vector storage. Its card defines
NO prefixes, so the empty pair above is a declaration, not a gap — and its benchmark
384-dim, confirmed against the card's 1_Pooling/config.json and our own table in
which was wrong and would have been refused at serve time by the declared-dim check.
arch is ModernBertModel, hidden 384, max_position_embeddings 8192, 256k vocab
Loaded in-container by sentence-transformers from repo@revision, baked at build time.
